0022600204.text: The Hornets host the Cavaliers in Charlotte's 11th game of the season, and they come in at 3-7 (2-4 at home) on a six-game losing streak, 11th in the East and 3 games back of the Southeast lead. Cleveland is 5-4 (4-1 at home) with a one-game winning streak, sitting 6th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Central, and it has one game still to play before this one, so its record reflects today. Charlotte is missing Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps), while Brandon Miller is day-to-day with groin soreness and is a game-time decision; the teams have not yet met in the 2026-27 season, and the Hornets lost 1-3 to Cleveland in 2025-26, including a 118-113 loss in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
